correctness.rationale: The recursion \(D_n-D_{n-1}\in\{0,1\}\) proves newest-vertex depth equals the height; leaf increments are exactly indicators of success-to-failure transitions. Geometric run lengths yield independent cycles \(T=K+1\), \(R=\lfloor K/2\rfloor+1\), \(S=\mathbf1_{\{K\ge1\}}\). Centered renewal rewards establish the bivariate Gaussian limit, and elementary geometric second moments yield the displayed Σ. The finite-state pair (X_n,B_n) has a uniform one-step p reset, proving geometric mixing and \(O(1)\) covariance remainders. Exact tree enumeration, independent dynamic-programming moments and geometric series were replayed by verify.py. Finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Height and leaf count are canonical distinct measures of longitudinal growth and branching. The exact joint covariance turns from strictly negative to strictly positive at \(q=(\sqrt5-1)/2\), where the fluctuations become asymptotically independent. This parameter sharpness is a meaningful structural phase boundary for the specific recently studied two-lag model, rather than an arbitrary finite numerical slice. The finite-state CLT methodology alone is not represented as the contribution.
